/-- A finite sequence of actual TW increments, with no semantic run premise. -/
inductive TagChain : Nat → Control → Control → Prop

  | snoc {n : Nat} {p q r : Control} (prefix : TagChain n p q)
      (edge : (source q).2 = .inc 1)
      (next : resolveControl (incPath (source q).1) = r) : TagChain (n + 1) p r

/-- Interfaces between checked loops and a bounded literal tag chain. -/
structure ConstructorShape where
  pop : UnpairCoreShape
  pair : PairShape
  scale : Scale4Shape

  exit : Control
  pop_main : pop.mainIndex = wsReg
  pop_to_pair : pop.exit = pair.copy.test
  pair_to_scale : pair.exit = scale.test
  tag_steps : TagChain tag.val scale.exit exit

section Model
variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

private theorem read_put_self (file x : V) (p : Fin 9) :
    regValue (put p x file) p = x := write_at file x p
private theorem read_put_other (file x : V) (p q : Fin 9) (h : p ≠ q) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = regValue file q := write_other file x p q h
private theorem put_same (p : Fin 9) (file : V) : put p (regValue file p) file = file :=
  write_same file p
private theorem put_twice (p : Fin 9) (x y file : V) :
    put p y (put p x file) = put p y file := write_overwrite file x y p
private theorem file_ext (x y : V) (h : ∀ i, regValue x i = regValue y i) : x = y := by
  rw [←file_reg x, ←file_reg y]
  exact congrArg fileValue (funext h)
private theorem read_put (p q : Fin 9) (x file : V) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = if p = q then x else regValue file q := by
  by_cases h : p = q
  · subst q
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact read_put_self file x p
  · simpa only [if_neg h] using read_put_other file x p q h

private theorem read_tw (file : V) :
    (physicalValues file).getD (Permutation252Frame.physOf 1) 0 = regValue file twReg :=
  physicalValues_getD file twReg

private theorem increment (p q : Control) (edge : (source p).2 = .inc 1)
    (next : resolveControl (incPath (source p).1) = q) (file : V) :
    ArithmeticControlStep254.stepValue (liveValue (number p : V) file) =
      liveValue (number q : V) (put twReg (regValue file twReg + 1) file) := by
  rw [step_inc p 1 edge, next, read_tw]
  rfl

/-- This finite induction concerns only a literal control chain; the file is internal. -/
theorem tagChain_run {n : Nat} {p q : Control} (chain : TagChain n p q) (file : V) :
    controlRun (n : V) (liveValue (number p : V) file) =
      liveValue (number q : V) (put twReg (regValue file twReg + (n : V)) file) := by
  induction chain generalizing file with
  | nil p => simp only [Nat.cast_zero, controlRun_zero, add_zero, put_same]
  | @snoc n p q r prefix edge next ih =>
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, controlRun_succ, ih,
      increment q r edge next, read_put_self, put_twice]
    simp only [add_assoc]

/-- The middle consumes arbitrary S1 and requires only S2=0. -/
def middleFile (tag : Fin 4) (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (tagged (tag.val : V) (regValue file s1Reg) (regValue file twReg))
    (put s1Reg 0 file)

theorem constructor_middle_run (c : ConstructorShape) (file : V)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number c.pair.copy.test : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.exit : V) (middleFile c.tag file) := by
  let p := cantor (regValue file s1Reg) (regValue file twReg)
  let g := pairFile file 0 0 p
  have hp : ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧
      controlRun time (liveValue (number c.pair.copy.test : V) file) =
        liveValue (number c.scale.test : V)
          (pairFile file 0 0 (regValue file s2Reg + p)) := by
    simpa only [c.pair_to_scale, p] using pair_run c.pair file
  obtain ⟨tp, htp, hpair⟩ := hp
  rw [h2, zero_add] at hpair
  have hgs2 : regValue g s2Reg = p := by
    dsimp only [g, pairFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg s2Reg (by decide), read_put_self]
  have hgtw : regValue g twReg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pairFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg twReg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ s2Reg twReg (by decide), read_put_self]
  let scaled := put twReg (4 * p) (put s2Reg 0 g)
  have hscale := scale_run c.scale g
  rw [hgs2, hgtw, zero_add] at hscale
  have htag := tagChain_run c.tag_steps scaled
  have hf : put twReg (regValue scaled twReg + (c.tag.val : V)) scaled = middleFile c.tag file := by
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    have hz : regValue file (5 : Fin 9) = 0 := h2
    by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, scaled, g, pairFile, middleFile, p, tagged, twReg, s1Reg, s2Reg]
    by_cases hi8 : i = (8 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, scaled, g, pairFile, middleFile, twReg, s1Reg, s2Reg]
    by_cases hi5 : i = (5 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, scaled, g, pairFile, middleFile, twReg, s1Reg, s2Reg, hz]
    simp [read_put, scaled, g, pairFile, middleFile, twReg, s1Reg, s2Reg,
      Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi8, Ne.symm hi5]
  rw [hf] at htag
  refine ⟨(tp + (6 * p + 1)) + (c.tag.val : V),
    le_trans htp (le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _))
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _))), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add (tp + (6 * p + 1)) (c.tag.val : V),
    controlRun_add tp (6 * p + 1), hpair, hscale]
  exact htag

/-- The complete file effect preserves all coordinates except TW and WS. -/
def constructorFile (tag : Fin 4) (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (tagged (tag.val : V) (first (regValue file wsReg)) (regValue file twReg))
    (put wsReg (second (regValue file wsReg)) file)

theorem constructorFile_other (tag : Fin 4) (file : V) (i : Fin 9)
    (ht : i ≠ twReg) (hs : i ≠ wsReg) :
    regValue (constructorFile tag file) i = regValue file i := by
  rw [constructorFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg i ht.symm,
    read_put_other _ _ wsReg i hs.symm]

/-- All unbounded clocks and data range over the arbitrary internal model. -/
theorem constructor_run (c : ConstructorShape) (file : V)
    (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0) (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number c.pop.readEntry : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.exit : V) (constructorFile c.tag file) := by
  let g := put s1Reg (first (regValue file wsReg))
    (put wsReg (second (regValue file wsReg)) file)
  have hp : ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number c.pop.readEntry : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.pair.copy.test : V) g := by
    simpa only [c.pop_main, c.pop_to_pair, g] using core_run c.pop file h1 h2
  obtain ⟨tp, htp, hpop⟩ := hp
  have hg2 : regValue g s2Reg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg s2Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ wsReg s2Reg (by decide)]
    exact h2
  have hf : middleFile c.tag g = constructorFile c.tag file := by
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    have hz : regValue file (8 : Fin 9) = 0 := h1
    by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, middleFile, g, constructorFile, twReg, wsReg, s1Reg]
    by_cases hi0 : i = (0 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, middleFile, g, constructorFile, twReg, wsReg, s1Reg]
    by_cases hi8 : i = (8 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, middleFile, g, constructorFile, twReg, wsReg, s1Reg, hz]
    simp [read_put, middleFile, g, constructorFile, twReg, wsReg, s1Reg,
      Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi0, Ne.symm hi8]
  obtain ⟨tm, _, hmiddle⟩ := constructor_middle_run c g hg2
  refine ⟨tp + tm, le_trans htp (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _)), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add, hpop, hmiddle, hf]

/-- The actual195→222 implication constructor, with every other field preserved. -/
theorem imp_constructor_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number impEntry : V) file) =
      liveValue (number impExit : V)
        (put twReg (wim (first (regValue file wsReg)) (regValue file twReg))
          (put wsReg (second (regValue file wsReg)) file)) := by
  simpa only [show impConstructor.pop.readEntry = impEntry from rfl,
    show impConstructor.exit = impExit from rfl,
    show impConstructor.tag = (0 : Fin 4) from rfl,
    constructorFile, Fin.val_zero, Nat.cast_zero, wim] using constructor_run impConstructor file h1 h2

end Model
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlConstructor254

/-!

with TW, scale by4, then execute the tag's finite TW-increment chain. The shapes
contain only actual instruction and control-target facts. Unbounded loops reuse
checked internal IΣ1 contracts. Files and existential total clocks remain

namespace SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlConstructor254

open ArithmeticCantor ArithmeticCode254 ArithmeticControlRun254

/-- A finite sequence of actual TW increments, with no semantic run premise. -/
inductive TagChain : Nat → Control → Control → Prop
  | nil (p : Control) : TagChain 0 p p
  | snoc {n : Nat} {p q r : Control} (prefix : TagChain n p q)
      (edge : (source q).2 = .inc 1)
      (next : resolveControl (incPath (source q).1) = r) : TagChain (n + 1) p r

/-- Interfaces between checked loops and a bounded literal tag chain. -/

  pop : UnpairCoreShape
  pair : PairShape
  scale : Scale4Shape
  tag : Fin 4
  exit : Control
  pop_main : pop.mainIndex = wsReg
  pop_to_pair : pop.exit = pair.copy.test

theorem tagChain_run {n : Nat} {p q : Control} (chain : TagChain n p q) (file : V) :
    controlRun (n : V) (liveValue (number p : V) file) =
      liveValue (number q : V) (put twReg (regValue file twReg + (n : V)) file) := by
  induction chain generalizing file with
  | nil p => simp only [Nat.cast_zero, controlRun_zero, add_zero, put_same]
  | @snoc n p q r prefix edge next ih =>
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, controlRun_succ, ih,
      increment q r edge next, read_put_self, put_twice]
    simp only [add_assoc]

/-- The middle consumes arbitrary S1 and requires only S2=0. -/
def middleFile (tag : Fin 4) (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (tagged (tag.val : V) (regValue file s1Reg) (regValue file twReg))
    (put s1Reg 0 file)

theorem constructor_middle_run (c : ConstructorShape) (file : V)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number c.pair.copy.test : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.exit : V) (middleFile c.tag file) := by
  let p := cantor (regValue file s1Reg) (regValue file twReg)
  let g := pairFile file 0 0 p
  have hp : ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧
      controlRun time (liveValue (number c.pair.copy.test : V) file) =
        liveValue (number c.scale.test : V)
          (pairFile file 0 0 (regValue file s2Reg + p)) := by
    simpa only [c.pair_to_scale, p] using pair_run c.pair file
  obtain ⟨tp, htp, hpair⟩ := hp
  rw [h2, zero_add] at hpair
  have hgs2 : regValue g s2Reg = p := by
    dsimp only [g, pairFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg s2Reg (by decide), read_put_self]
  have hgtw : regValue g twReg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pairFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg twReg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ s2Reg twReg (by decide), read_put_self]
  let scaled := put twReg (4 * p) (put s2Reg 0 g)
  have hscale := scale_run c.scale g
  rw [hgs2, hgtw, zero_add] at hscale
  have htag := tagChain_run c.tag_steps scaled
  have hf : put twReg (regValue scaled twReg + (c.tag.val : V)) scaled = middleFile c.tag file := by
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    have hz : regValue file (5 : Fin 9) = 0 := h2
    by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, scaled, g, pairFile, middleFile, p, tagged, twReg, s1Reg, s2Reg]
    by_cases hi8 : i = (8 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, scaled, g, pairFile, middleFile, twReg, s1Reg, s2Reg]
    by_cases hi5 : i = (5 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, scaled, g, pairFile, middleFile, twReg, s1Reg, s2Reg, hz]
    simp [read_put, scaled, g, pairFile, middleFile, twReg, s1Reg, s2Reg,
      Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi8, Ne.symm hi5]
  rw [hf] at htag
  refine ⟨(tp + (6 * p + 1)) + (c.tag.val : V),
    le_trans htp (le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _))
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _))), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add (tp + (6 * p + 1)) (c.tag.val : V),
    controlRun_add tp (6 * p + 1), hpair, hscale]
  exact htag

/-- The complete file effect preserves all coordinates except TW and WS. -/
def constructorFile (tag : Fin 4) (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (tagged (tag.val : V) (first (regValue file wsReg)) (regValue file twReg))
    (put wsReg (second (regValue file wsReg)) file)

theorem constructorFile_other (tag : Fin 4) (file : V) (i : Fin 9)
    (ht : i ≠ twReg) (hs : i ≠ wsReg) :
    regValue (constructorFile tag file) i = regValue file i := by
  rw [constructorFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg i ht.symm,
    read_put_other _ _ wsReg i hs.symm]

/-- All unbounded clocks and data range over the arbitrary internal model. -/
theorem constructor_run (c : ConstructorShape) (file : V)
    (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0) (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number c.pop.readEntry : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.exit : V) (constructorFile c.tag file) := by
  let g := put s1Reg (first (regValue file wsReg))
    (put wsReg (second (regValue file wsReg)) file)
  have hp : ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number c.pop.readEntry : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.pair.copy.test : V) g := by
    simpa only [c.pop_main, c.pop_to_pair, g] using core_run c.pop file h1 h2
  obtain ⟨tp, htp, hpop⟩ := hp
  have hg2 : regValue g s2Reg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg s2Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ wsReg s2Reg (by decide)]
    exact h2
  have hf : middleFile c.tag g = constructorFile c.tag file := by
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    have hz : regValue file (8 : Fin 9) = 0 := h1
    by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, middleFile, g, constructorFile, twReg, wsReg, s1Reg]
    by_cases hi0 : i = (0 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, middleFile, g, constructorFile, twReg, wsReg, s1Reg]
    by_cases hi8 : i = (8 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, middleFile, g, constructorFile, twReg, wsReg, s1Reg, hz]
    simp [read_put, middleFile, g, constructorFile, twReg, wsReg, s1Reg,
      Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi0, Ne.symm hi8]
  obtain ⟨tm, _, hmiddle⟩ := constructor_middle_run c g hg2
  refine ⟨tp + tm, le_trans htp (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _)), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add, hpop, hmiddle, hf]

/-- The actual195→222 implication constructor, with every other field preserved. -/
theorem imp_constructor_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number impEntry : V) file) =
      liveValue (number impExit : V)

          (put wsReg (second (regValue file wsReg)) file)) := by
  simpa only [show impConstructor.pop.readEntry = impEntry from rfl,
    show impConstructor.exit = impExit from rfl,
    show impConstructor.tag = (0 : Fin 4) from rfl,
    constructorFile, Fin.val_zero, Nat.cast_zero, wim] using constructor_run impConstructor file h1 h2

end Model
end SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.ArithmeticControlConstructor254

from pathlib import Path
import ast,difflib,hashlib,json,re,shutil
B=Path('/tmp/zfc-arithmetic-constructor-template')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
S=B/'ArithmeticControlConstructor254.lean';G=B/'check.py';A=B/'Audit.lean'
assert sha(S)=='732c3a9215e8d08e80d57c157058bf3e5b741e124a7be130d7dddd94b7dca0ae'
assert sha(G)=='5c3d567b432fb771a9b951b567a7e0f836226767ef08023573dfc28028702416'
E=B/'run1/verification.json';e=json.loads(E.read_text())
assert e['status']=='FAIL' and [x['label'] for x in e['commands']]==['source']
initial=sorted(q for q in B.rglob('*') if (q.is_file() or q.is_symlink()) and 'history' not in q.relative_to(B).parts)
H=B/'history/run1-before-literal-target-repair';H.mkdir(parents=True)
rows=[];excluded=[]
for q in initial:
 if q.is_symlink():excluded.append(dict(path=str(q),kind='symlink',target=str(q.resolve())));continue
 data=q.read_bytes()
 try:data.decode('utf-8')
 except UnicodeDecodeError:excluded.append(dict(path=str(q),kind='binary',sha256=sha(q)));continue
 dest=H/q.relative_to(B);dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);shutil.copyfile(q,dest)
 assert sha(q)==sha(dest);rows.append(dict(original=str(q),archived=str(dest),sha256=sha(q)))
(H/'archive.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(files=rows,excluded=excluded),indent=2)+'\n')
s=S.read_text();t=s.replace('(prefix : TagChain n p q)','(prior : TagChain n p q)').replace('@snoc n p q r prefix edge next ih','@snoc n p q r prior edge next ih')
assert t!=s and ' prefix ' not in t
helper='''/-- Resolve a literal target through its finite tree path, avoiding catalogue search. -/
private theorem literal_target (P : List Bool) (q : Control)
    (hw : RMBisim.twalk ActualTree254.tree P 0 =
      some ((source q).2, (source q).1.length))
    (hc : consume P (source q).1.length = (source q).1) : resolveControl P = q := by
  have hw' : walk Prog254.program (Prog254.program.nnodes + 1) Prog254.program.root P 0 =
      some ((source q).2, (source q).1.length) := by
    rw [RMBisim.walk_root, ActualTree254.tree_eq]
    exact hw
  apply source_injective
  rw [resolve_source _ _ _ hw', hc]

'''
anchor='private def impPop : UnpairCoreShape where\n';assert t.count(anchor)==1;t=t.replace(anchor,helper+anchor)
pattern=r'^(  (?:next_\w+|\w+_target) := )by rfl$'
fields=re.findall(pattern,t,re.M);assert len(fields)==37,len(fields)
t=re.sub(pattern,r'\1by\n    apply literal_target <;> rfl',t,flags=re.M)
N=B/'source-v2/ArithmeticControlConstructor254.lean';N.parent.mkdir();N.write_text(t)
g=G.read_text();gg=g.replace("SOURCE_SHA='"+sha(S)+"'","SOURCE_SHA='"+sha(N)+"'").replace("else Path('"+str(S)+"')","else Path('"+str(N)+"')")
NG=B/'check-v2.py';NG.write_text(gg);ast.parse(gg)
assert gg.replace(sha(N),sha(S)).replace(str(N),str(S))==g
for name,x,y in [('literal-target-source.diff',s,t),('literal-target-guard.diff',g,gg)]:
 (B/name).write_text(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(x.splitlines(True),y.splitlines(True),fromfile='run1/original',tofile='run2/successor')))
r=dict(status='SOURCE_ONLY_LITERAL_TARGET_REPAIR',failed_record=dict(path=str(E),sha256=sha(E)),failure=dict(source_failed=True,audit_not_reached=True,diagnostics='Reserved prefix binder plus 37 literal resolver recursion-depth failures; downstream TagChain diagnostics retained.'),original_source=dict(path=str(S),sha256=sha(S)),successor_source=dict(path=str(N),sha256=sha(N)),original_guard=dict(path=str(G),sha256=sha(G)),successor_guard=dict(path=str(NG),sha256=sha(NG)),audit_unchanged=dict(path=str(A),sha256=sha(A)),archive=dict(path=str(H/'archive.json'),sha256=sha(H/'archive.json'),files=len(rows)),target_field_count=len(fields),delta='Rename two reserved prefix binders to prior. Add one private generic literal target proof through RMBisim.twalk, resolve_source and source_injective; use it for the 37 target fields. All target statements, source instructions, arithmetic proofs, audit7/13, parents and limits unchanged. Guard source SHA/default path only.',scope_correction='Earlier source-only review missed the reserved binder and did not establish elaboration of the literal resolver reductions. Root actual failure is preserved; successor remains uncompiled.',guard_or_compiler_executed=False)
O=B/'literal-target-repair.json';O.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(dict(source=sha(N),guard=sha(NG),repair=sha(O),archive_files=len(rows)),indent=2))

`imp_constructor_run` instantiates the actual controls 195→222 with tag 0, yielding `wim(first(oldWS), oldTW)`. TagChain contains only increment instructions and resolved target equalities; its finite structural induction does not assume a semantic execution theorem. The audit has seven named probes and thirteen typed clients, including generic chains of lengths 0, 1, 2 and 3. No separate actual occurrence is claimed for tags 1, 2 or 3.

variable {V : Type*} [ORingStructure V] [V↓[ℒₒᵣ] ⊧* 𝗜𝚺₁]

private theorem read_put_self (file x : V) (p : Fin 9) :
    regValue (put p x file) p = x := write_at file x p
private theorem read_put_other (file x : V) (p q : Fin 9) (h : p ≠ q) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = regValue file q := write_other file x p q h
private theorem put_same (p : Fin 9) (file : V) : put p (regValue file p) file = file :=
  write_same file p
private theorem put_twice (p : Fin 9) (x y file : V) :
    put p y (put p x file) = put p y file := write_overwrite file x y p
private theorem file_ext (x y : V) (h : ∀ i, regValue x i = regValue y i) : x = y := by
  rw [←file_reg x, ←file_reg y]
  exact congrArg fileValue (funext h)
private theorem read_put (p q : Fin 9) (x file : V) :
    regValue (put p x file) q = if p = q then x else regValue file q := by
  by_cases h : p = q
  · subst q
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact read_put_self file x p
  · simpa only [if_neg h] using read_put_other file x p q h

private theorem read_tw (file : V) :
    (physicalValues file).getD (Permutation252Frame.physOf 1) 0 = regValue file twReg :=
  physicalValues_getD file twReg

private theorem increment (p q : Control) (edge : (source p).2 = .inc 1)
    (next : resolveControl (incPath (source p).1) = q) (file : V) :
    ArithmeticControlStep254.stepValue (liveValue (number p : V) file) =
      liveValue (number q : V) (put twReg (regValue file twReg + 1) file) := by
  rw [step_inc p 1 edge, next, read_tw]
  rfl

/-- This finite induction concerns only a literal control chain; the file is internal. -/
theorem tagChain_run {n : Nat} {p q : Control} (chain : TagChain n p q) (file : V) :
    controlRun (n : V) (liveValue (number p : V) file) =
      liveValue (number q : V) (put twReg (regValue file twReg + (n : V)) file) := by
  induction chain generalizing file with
  | nil p => simp only [Nat.cast_zero, controlRun_zero, add_zero, put_same]
  | @snoc n p q r prior edge next ih =>
    rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, controlRun_succ, ih,
      increment q r edge next, read_put_self, put_twice]
    simp only [add_assoc]

/-- The middle consumes arbitrary S1 and requires only S2=0. -/
def middleFile (tag : Fin 4) (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (tagged (tag.val : V) (regValue file s1Reg) (regValue file twReg))
    (put s1Reg 0 file)

theorem constructor_middle_run (c : ConstructorShape) (file : V)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number c.pair.copy.test : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.exit : V) (middleFile c.tag file) := by
  let p := cantor (regValue file s1Reg) (regValue file twReg)
  let g := pairFile file 0 0 p
  have hp : ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧
      controlRun time (liveValue (number c.pair.copy.test : V) file) =
        liveValue (number c.scale.test : V)
          (pairFile file 0 0 (regValue file s2Reg + p)) := by
    simpa only [c.pair_to_scale, p] using pair_run c.pair file
  obtain ⟨tp, htp, hpair⟩ := hp
  rw [h2, zero_add] at hpair
  have hgs2 : regValue g s2Reg = p := by
    dsimp only [g, pairFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg s2Reg (by decide), read_put_self]
  have hgtw : regValue g twReg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g, pairFile]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg twReg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ s2Reg twReg (by decide), read_put_self]
  let scaled := put twReg (4 * p) (put s2Reg 0 g)
  have hscale := scale_run c.scale g
  rw [hgs2, hgtw, zero_add] at hscale
  have htag := tagChain_run c.tag_steps scaled
  have hf : put twReg (regValue scaled twReg + (c.tag.val : V)) scaled = middleFile c.tag file := by
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    have hz : regValue file (5 : Fin 9) = 0 := h2
    by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, scaled, g, pairFile, middleFile, p, tagged, twReg, s1Reg, s2Reg]
    by_cases hi8 : i = (8 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, scaled, g, pairFile, middleFile, twReg, s1Reg, s2Reg]
    by_cases hi5 : i = (5 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, scaled, g, pairFile, middleFile, twReg, s1Reg, s2Reg, hz]
    simp [read_put, scaled, g, pairFile, middleFile, twReg, s1Reg, s2Reg,
      Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi8, Ne.symm hi5]
  rw [hf] at htag
  refine ⟨(tp + (6 * p + 1)) + (c.tag.val : V),
    le_trans htp (le_trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _))
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _))), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add (tp + (6 * p + 1)) (c.tag.val : V),
    controlRun_add tp (6 * p + 1), hpair, hscale]
  exact htag

/-- The complete file effect preserves all coordinates except TW and WS. -/
def constructorFile (tag : Fin 4) (file : V) : V :=
  put twReg (tagged (tag.val : V) (first (regValue file wsReg)) (regValue file twReg))
    (put wsReg (second (regValue file wsReg)) file)

theorem constructorFile_other (tag : Fin 4) (file : V) (i : Fin 9)
    (ht : i ≠ twReg) (hs : i ≠ wsReg) :
    regValue (constructorFile tag file) i = regValue file i := by
  rw [constructorFile, read_put_other _ _ twReg i ht.symm,
    read_put_other _ _ wsReg i hs.symm]

/-- All unbounded clocks and data range over the arbitrary internal model. -/
theorem constructor_run (c : ConstructorShape) (file : V)
    (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0) (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number c.pop.readEntry : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.exit : V) (constructorFile c.tag file) := by
  let g := put s1Reg (first (regValue file wsReg))
    (put wsReg (second (regValue file wsReg)) file)
  have hp : ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number c.pop.readEntry : V) file) =
      liveValue (number c.pair.copy.test : V) g := by
    simpa only [c.pop_main, c.pop_to_pair, g] using core_run c.pop file h1 h2
  obtain ⟨tp, htp, hpop⟩ := hp
  have hg2 : regValue g s2Reg = 0 := by
    dsimp only [g]
    rw [read_put_other _ _ s1Reg s2Reg (by decide),
      read_put_other _ _ wsReg s2Reg (by decide)]
    exact h2
  have hf : middleFile c.tag g = constructorFile c.tag file := by
    apply file_ext
    intro i
    have hz : regValue file (8 : Fin 9) = 0 := h1
    by_cases hi2 : i = (2 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, middleFile, g, constructorFile, twReg, wsReg, s1Reg]
    by_cases hi0 : i = (0 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, middleFile, g, constructorFile, twReg, wsReg, s1Reg]
    by_cases hi8 : i = (8 : Fin 9)
    · subst i
      simp [read_put, middleFile, g, constructorFile, twReg, wsReg, s1Reg, hz]
    simp [read_put, middleFile, g, constructorFile, twReg, wsReg, s1Reg,
      Ne.symm hi2, Ne.symm hi0, Ne.symm hi8]
  obtain ⟨tm, _, hmiddle⟩ := constructor_middle_run c g hg2
  refine ⟨tp + tm, le_trans htp (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Arithmetic.zero_le _)), ?_⟩
  rw [controlRun_add, hpop, hmiddle, hf]

/-- The actual195→222 implication constructor, with every other field preserved. -/
theorem imp_constructor_run (file : V) (h1 : regValue file s1Reg = 0)
    (h2 : regValue file s2Reg = 0) :
    ∃ time : V, 1 ≤ time ∧ controlRun time (liveValue (number impEntry : V) file) =
      liveValue (number impExit : V)
        (put twReg (wim (first (regValue file wsReg)) (regValue file twReg))
          (put wsReg (second (regValue file wsReg)) file)) := by
  simpa only [show impConstructor.pop.readEntry = impEntry from rfl,
    show impConstructor.exit = impExit from rfl,
    show impConstructor.tag = (0 : Fin 4) from rfl,
    constructorFile, Fin.val_zero, Nat.cast_zero, wim] using constructor_run impConstructor file h1 h2

end Model

# Internal constructor template and the implication occurrence

`ArithmeticControlConstructor254` proves a reusable constructor contract and its actual implication occurrence at catalogue controls **195→222**. In an arbitrary internal model of IΣ₁, the input is a complete register file with both scratch coordinates zero. The theorem supplies a positive internal execution time and changes exactly:

- `TW := tagged(tag, first(oldWS), oldTW)`;
- `WS := second(oldWS)`.

Every other coordinate is preserved. The middle contract requires only `S2 = 0` and accepts arbitrary `S1`, constructing `tagged(tag, oldS1, oldTW)` while clearing `S1`.

The generic shape connects the checked WS-pop, pairing and fourfold-scale loops with literal control equalities. Its tag is in `Fin 4`; `TagChain` records a finite sequence of actual TW-increment instructions and targets. The chain proof uses structural induction on this finite syntax. Unbounded data and execution clocks range over the internal arithmetic model. The generic theorem does not assert that every tag already has a separately checked occurrence in the program.

`imp_constructor_run` instantiates tag zero at controls 195→222, producing `wim(first(oldWS), oldTW)`. The unchanged typed audit has seven named axiom probes and thirteen callers, including finite chain lengths 0, 1, 2 and 3, generic middle/full runs, coordinate preservation, and a concrete paired-WS client.

The selected root run passed source and audit with zero warnings under default Lean proof limits, one thread, a 4,096 MiB limit and a shared 120-second budget. The exact evidence and dependency pairs are in [the verification record](results/arithmetic-control-constructor254-verification.json); [the independent review](results/arithmetic-control-constructor254-review.json) checks the recorded current inputs, actual providers, raw output and pre-audit fresh-object capture. The imported closure has 100 project modules, six cached Foundation/Mathlib boundary pairs (five directly imported), and Init/Omega. The legacy MP parent recorded its source object before audit but lacked the later fresh-first-provider field. The guard resolves its recorded search path now and states that distinction explicitly.

The original source attempt failed before the audit: two uses of the reserved token `prefix` caused syntax errors, and 35 literal `resolveControl` reductions reached the recursion-depth limit. The repaired source renames those binders to `prior` and proves the same 35 targets through the exact finite tree walk, `resolve_source`, and `source_injective`. Independent parsing checks all 35 original target identities. No instruction, target proposition, arithmetic contract, audit caller or proof limit changed. [The exact history](results/arithmetic-control-constructor254-history.json) preserves the failed attempt, old source and guard, repair drafts and metadata failure, both preparations, successful raw logs and earlier source-only reviews with their original scope.

This unit does not complete the AX branch, the interpreter/Enum comparison, an internal binary-machine simulation, or the PA consistency equivalence.

The maintained [guard](check_arithmetic_control_constructor254.py) changes only the source, audit and provider-proposal default paths from the executed guard. Replay requires the exact historical dependency/cache providers in the verification record; this publication does not certify a clean-checkout dependency rebuild. A preparation-only run does not invoke Lean:

```sh
python3 -B Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/check_arithmetic_control_constructor254.py \
  --repo "$PWD" \
  --dependency-root /path/to/the/recorded/dependency-root \
  --mp-evidence Computability/BusyBeaver/Research/ZFC/results/arithmetic-control-mp254-verification.json \
  --output /tmp/fresh-constructor-preparation \
  --prepare-only
```

The provider inventory and recorded dependency root must match the historical record exactly. After reviewing that preparation, omitting `--prepare-only` in a fresh output directory runs source and audit under the same bounds.

S=B/'ArithmeticControlConstructor254.lean';G=B/'check.py';A=B/'Audit.lean'
assert sha(S)=='732c3a9215e8d08e80d57c157058bf3e5b741e124a7be130d7dddd94b7dca0ae'
assert sha(G)=='5c3d567b432fb771a9b951b567a7e0f836226767ef08023573dfc28028702416'
E=B/'run1/verification.json';e=json.loads(E.read_text())
assert e['status']=='FAIL' and [x['label'] for x in e['commands']]==['source']
H=B/'history/run1-before-literal-target-repair';archive=json.loads((H/'archive.json').read_text());rows=archive['files']
for row in rows:assert sha(row['archived'])==row['sha256']
s=S.read_text();t=s.replace('(prefix : TagChain n p q)','(prior : TagChain n p q)').replace('@snoc n p q r prefix edge next ih','@snoc n p q r prior edge next ih')
assert t!=s and ' prefix ' not in t
helper='''/-- Resolve a literal target through its finite tree path, avoiding catalogue search. -/
private theorem literal_target (P : List Bool) (q : Control)
    (hw : RMBisim.twalk ActualTree254.tree P 0 =
      some ((source q).2, (source q).1.length))
    (hc : consume P (source q).1.length = (source q).1) : resolveControl P = q := by
  have hw' : walk Prog254.program (Prog254.program.nnodes + 1) Prog254.program.root P 0 =
      some ((source q).2, (source q).1.length) := by
    rw [RMBisim.walk_root, ActualTree254.tree_eq]
    exact hw
  apply source_injective
  rw [resolve_source _ _ _ hw', hc]

'''
anchor='private def impPop : UnpairCoreShape where\n';assert t.count(anchor)==1;t=t.replace(anchor,helper+anchor)
pattern=r'^(  (?!move_target)(?:next_\w+|\w+_target) := )by rfl$'
